findings.title: Virtual Environment Files Polluting Filesystem Audit Metrics

evidence.observation: Virtual environment package files from .venv are being captured in repository doc_files and config_files inventories, inflating doc_count to 1891

proposed_action.description: Update filesystem audit crawler ignore patterns to exclude .venv and site-packages directories.

findings.expected_benefit: Ensures accurate metric reporting and prevents vendor library metadata from polluting repository inventory.
findings.policy_decision_rationale: Category: observability_gap; Evidence strength: None; Confidence: 0.90; Risk: low; Automation: needs_more_evidence; Reason: Evidence insufficient (need strong)

findings.title: Available Local Models Unassigned in Model Router Policy

evidence.observation: Models qwen3.5:9b, qwen3.5:4b, qwen3.5:2b, and gemma4:12b are loaded/available in Ollama but not referenced in any router task_type policy

proposed_action.description: Audit available model inventory and either allocate unassigned models (e.g. qwen3.5 family, gemma4:12b) to routing tasks or prune unneeded models from Ollama storage.

findings.expected_benefit: Optimizes local VRAM/disk usage and aligns active routing policy with available model capabilities.
